from.place: Concrete vector-bundle coefficient, chart exchange, and local trace

title: Concrete vector-bundle coefficient, chart exchange, and local trace
statement: For N>0, a finite commutative ring A with NA=0, a Noetherian scheme S on which N is invertible and a constant-rank vector bundle E of rank d [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], retain exactly the coefficient, compact-support source, cohomology sheaf, inverse-frame chart, coefficient comparison, local trace and normalization predicate of [def-amb-vector-integration]. This is their relocation only: C_pi=R pi_! pi^*(ordered tensor of d shifted Tate lines), L_pi=H^0(C_pi). A chart is the tower-to-affine-space comparison followed by the inverse frame and the open inclusion into E. Its square over V→S is Cartesian. The local trace is the actual compact-support exchange for this square, then the canonical coefficient comparison and the affine counit. Normalization demands these restrictions for every frame and normalized data. No global trace is defined here.

source.place: The concentration, overlap, and degree-zero gluing argument

proof.text: Preserve the original explicit constructions, signatures, attributes and bodies. The affine relative spectrum and the finite locally free frame cover give the existing geometric properties.
The inverse frame is an isomorphism over its open; paste its isomorphism square with the open inverse-image square. This proves vectorIntegrationChart_isPullback.
Define the coefficient comparison by inverse-image composition and the canonical Tate tensor comparisons. Compose the actual exchange with that comparison and the existing ordered affine counit.

lean.statement:
def vectorIntegrationLocalTrace (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t T hT)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d] (V : S.Opens)
    (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d F V) :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A V.ι).obj (vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S d F) ⟶
      ordinaryFiniteUnit A V.toScheme
